title: AI-Powered Marketing: Campaigns, Voice, and Video
cardSummary: A two-voice podcast of The 18% Problem and a captioned Mercury CRM infographic campaign.
lede: I adapted my thesis into a short conversation for readers who want to listen, and developed an infographic campaign that introduces Mercury CRM’s AI agency offer to local-services entrepreneurs.

audio.title: The 18% Problem
audio.description: A two-person audio adaptation of my thesis on the management layer AI agents need.

approach: Give readers an audio option. Use a conversational host and guest to unpack the inventory figure and the thesis in everyday terms.
Build the campaign around a familiar memory. Use infographics and captions to connect the local computer technician story to Mercury CRM’s offer.
Give each voice a role. Use ElevenLabs MCP for the host and guest, with separate voice direction for the campaign.
